title: delegated-authority-exceeds-permitted-scope

proposition.statement: A delegated actor must not exercise or be credited with authority beyond the scope that the authoritative delegation chain permits.

preconditions: A principal or other competent authority grants a bounded scope to a delegate.
The delegate attempts or is credited with an action outside that bounded scope.
The relying decision depends on the delegation as authority for the attempted action.

trigger.statement: The relying system evaluates an action whose requested scope exceeds, is not included in, or cannot be derived from the authoritative delegation scope.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence of the delegation chain linking the actor to the authority source.
Evidence that the authority source is competent for the delegated scope.
Evidence defining the permitted delegated scope and any attenuation or downstream-delegation constraints.
Evidence sufficient to establish that the scope statement originates from the authoritative delegation source.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS for an action whose scope is outside the scope established by the authoritative delegation chain.
The system treats an omitted, unresolved, or unverified delegation scope as unrestricted authority.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the initial authority failure tranche.
